name: ballpark
description: Ballpark, a daily general-knowledge game. This milestone is Classic mode, local only.

scripts.dev: npm run db:setup -w @ballpark/api && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ballpark/api" "npm run dev -w @ballpark/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ballpark/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ballpark/api && npm run typecheck -w @ballpark/web
scripts.test: npm run seed:check -w @ballpark/api && npm run test -w @ballpark/shared && npm run test -w @ballpark/api && npm run check:bundle
